## Requirements (from the contract §In-scope)
1. Derive + **materialise** the accountability links (deployment↔vendor↔contract↔funding↔policy↔
   oversight) as **labelled inference** over resolved entities — new sqitch change (deploy/revert/
   verify), append-only, idempotent (+0); every derived edge cites its establishing claims (no
   synthetic certainty). Follow the P28.1-P28.5 materialization pattern (nullable `input_digest` +
   partial UNIQUE index; `INSERT … ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`; no UPDATE/DELETE).
2. Enrich the per-jurisdiction dossiers (via the P28.5-refreshed surface) with the governance chain —
   where evidence exists; gaps shown honestly (never a fabricated link).

## Acceptance criteria (from the contract)
- [ ] accountability links materialised as labelled inference over resolved entities, each citing its
      establishing claims (new sqitch change; append-only) *(deterministic + live-gated)*
- [ ] a real dossier shows the deployment→vendor→contract→funding→policy→oversight chain where
      evidence exists; gaps shown honestly *(deterministic)*
- [ ] `make check` + `make test-db` + build-memory green *(deterministic)*

## Cross-cutting invariants
Every inference labelled with its establishing claims; NO assertion beyond committed evidence (§3.1);
append-only (no UPDATE/DELETE); **procured ≠ deployed** — the predicate-layer guard preserved (a
procurement/contract claim does NOT become a deployment link; the two-layer separation holds); never a
total; Part VIII (tier-0-only reads). Reuse-not-reimplement (SIG-ENG-035): `reconcile.model.Inference`
(the labelled L4 value object) + the P13.x `db` accountability entities + the P28.1 resolution / P28.2
edges are CONSUMED, not re-derived.

## Plan
- **DB (sqitch `accountability_link_materialize`):** the accountability link is an L4 **labelled
  inference** — it belongs in `inference.derived_fact` (Appendix C.6 L4, SIG-ONTO-002: an inference can
  NEVER be mistaken for an observation — this IS the procured≠deployed two-layer guard at the storage
  layer). ALTER `inference.derived_fact` ADD nullable `input_digest text` + partial UNIQUE index
  (`derived_fact_input_digest_key`) — exactly the P28.1-5 idempotency contract. Additive/back-compat
  (any pre-existing derived_fact row, digest NULL, is unaffected).
- **`inference/src/inference/accountability.py`** (the new materializer — reuses `inference/` +
  `reconcile.model.Inference`): read the accountability-layer entity-ref claims that connect a
  RESOLVED deployment (entity_type='deployment') to its vendor/contract/funding/policy/oversight, via
  the operator/owner/purchaser org, and materialize each discovered link as an append-only, idempotent
  `inference.derived_fact` row (predicate `accountability_link:<link_type>`, value_json carrying the
  object + chain role, `input_claim_ids` = the establishing claims). The guard: anchor ONLY on
  existing deployment entities; `assert_not_deployment_link` refuses any deployment-layer predicate as
  a link_type; a procurement/contract claim yields `procured_under_contract` (accountability layer),
  never `deployed`. Honest gaps: no establishing claim → no link (never fabricated).
  - `read_materialized_accountability_links(conn)` — the P28.5-style read seam (deterministic,
    `WHERE input_digest IS NOT NULL`, every row carries its establishing claims).
  - `materialize_accountability_links_from_dsn(dsn, ...)` — CLI convenience.
- **`inference/src/inference/cli.py`** — add `materialize-accountability-links --dsn [--jurisdiction]
  [--role]` (mirror `materialize-coverage`).
- **`exports/src/exports/spine_export.py`** — add the seam to `_MATERIALIZED_SEAMS` (auto-threaded
  through `fetch_materialized_graph`); pull `m_acct_links` off `raw` and pass to `_dossiers`, which
  emits governance-chain `Row`s into the existing `policy` + `accountability_events` dossier sections
  (frozen `web/src/lib/dossier.ts` `Section`/`Row` contract — no new IA/field/plumbing; P28.5 owns the
  plumbing). Empty links → today's output unchanged (honest absence).
- Live: prove the FULL deterministic path over seeded PG18+PostGIS (`make test-db`); the hosted run is
  deferred (`D-R6.6-ACCOUNTABILITY`, BL-057) with the exact re-run command — no fabricated hosted count.

## Evidence report
P28.6 connects the accountability layer — the §11.11-11.18 contract/funding/policy/oversight entities —
to the resolved deployments/orgs (P28.1) as **labelled L4 inference**. A NEW sqitch change
`accountability_link_materialize` adds the P28.1-5 idempotency contract (nullable `input_digest` +
partial UNIQUE index) to `inference.derived_fact` — the L4 namespace that by construction (SIG-ONTO-002)
can never be mistaken for an observation, which IS the **procured ≠ deployed** two-layer guard at the
storage layer. `inference.accountability.materialize_accountability_links` reads the resolved deployment
anchors (`merged_into IS NULL`) + the accountability-layer entity-ref claims and assembles the
**deployment→vendor→contract→funding→policy→oversight** chain through the operator org — a contract is
reached because the deployment's operator is the contract's buyer; the vendor because it is that
contract's seller; the funder because the operator is the funding instrument's recipient — writing each
link as an append-only, idempotent `derived_fact` row whose `input_claim_ids` cites its establishing
claims (no synthetic certainty, §3.1). `assert_not_deployment_link` refuses any deployment-layer
predicate as a link type, and a bare procurement (`contracted_device_count`) claim produces NO link —
an honest gap, proven over real PG. The dossier enrichment (`exports.spine_export._dossiers`, consuming
the new `read_materialized_accountability_links` seam threaded through `_MATERIALIZED_SEAMS`) shows the
chain per jurisdiction — rows on the FROZEN `web/src/lib/dossier.ts` Section/Row contract (no new IA,
no web change) + a structured `governance_chain` field with honest `not_researched` gaps for the
segments with no evidence; an unmaterialized spine leaves the dossier byte-identical (P28.5 owns the
plumbing). No new ADR (ADR-099 materialize-at-scale posture + the L4 namespace cover it). `make check`
exit 0; `make test-db` 175 passed (the full chain materialized + idempotent +0 + procured≠deployed +
the dossier chain end-to-end over real PG18+PostGIS); validators exit 0. The hosted materialization is
honestly deferred (D-R6.6-ACCOUNTABILITY, BL-057) with the exact re-run command — no fabricated hosted
link count.
